title: Infinitely many elliptic curves over $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ of exact ranks 4 and 6 with $j$-invariant 1728
summary: For each $r\in\{4,6\}$, we construct an explicit one-parameter family of elliptic curves over $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ containing infinitely many pairwise nonisomorphic curves genuinely defined over $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ with $j$-invariant $1728$ and rank exactly $r$. We construct explicit $\mathbb{Q}(i)$-rational points to bound the ranks from below. Kai's theorem on prime values of linear patterns over number fields provides specializations with controlled local behavior, allowing us to obtain matching upper bounds via $[1+i]$-descent.
